''See also: [[Aunt Charity Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Akura Charity]] is a powerful [[Sage]] and [[Archlord]] within the [[Akura clan]] who possesses legendary passion for humanity. Despite being [[Mercy]]'s grand-niece, she is over a century older than her and is referred to as [[Mercy]]'s aunt. [[Charity]] is known for her disciplined nature, often maintaining an expressionless or calm demeanor, though she can be perceived as unnerving by others. She adheres strictly to rules and fairness unless a deviation serves the greater benefit of her family. Her philosophy is rooted in the [[Akura clan]]'s belief that humanity must be harsh to survive and protect civilization from the chaos of the wilderness. [[Charity]] often dresses in simple, practical clothing, such as plain garments and stained smocks, resembling a worker or artist. She has the ability to travel through shadows and has demonstrated significant power, such as using a shield to intercept a blow from a [[Dreadgod]]. While she is highly capable, she has expressed frustration when unable to intervene in certain situations. She is deeply connected to her family, mourning the loss of her grand-nephew Akura Harmony{{!}}Harmony and maintaining a strong bond with her grandmother.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Aunt [[Charity]] has been seen carrying a demon-faced shield. She also gathered [[Mercy]] up in her arms.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|She is a great listener, though others find her to be unnerving. Currently in recovery, she provides advice such as telling Akura Pride{{!}}Pride to rest or instructing [[Mercy]] to maintain a calm head and cool heart.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|She is skilled at making good [[elixirs]]. Additionally, she has used a [[void key]] to retrieve a pill and possesses the strength to hold back [[Akura Malice]] from destroying a region.}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|During the relief efforts, Aunt [[Charity]] noted that [[Lindon]] had been actively assisting with the work.
